verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party revenue recovery docs document Smart Retries, which automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn. They also document recovery analytics on subscription payment failure and recovery rates, all without code, so the automatic smart-retry core is clearly delivered. However, the evidence never mentions recovery or dunning emails to customers, and there is no detail on retry configuration and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented recovery/dunning email notifications to customers, detail on retry scheduling/configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails

citations.quote: Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Recovery analytics: Analyze subscription payment failure rates, recovery rates, and recent failed payments for top customers.
None of the features require you to write code, so you can start recovering revenue today.
